purpose: Public-safe orchestration policy for private real-life reference assets. No private source URLs, file IDs, family names, or identity assertions belong in this repository.

privateAuthority.rule: Resolve original media, provenance, identity confidence, and consent only from approved private authority sources. Never infer private source identifiers from this public manifest.

truthAndSafetyRules: Source labels and captions are provenance metadata, not facial identification.
Do not identify a real person from appearance alone.
Unconfirmed identities remain unconfirmed until explicitly verified by an authorized source.
Portrait and likeness use remains approval-gated.
Generated or staged material must never be labeled archival media.
Government ID, legal, medical, benefits, financial, account, recovery, and exact-address material stays outside the production-media vault.
Private Gmail URLs, Drive IDs, contact sheets, exact source filenames when sensitive, and other private pointers must not be committed to public repositories.
Cinematic recreation must be clearly distinguished from documentary or archival evidence.
implementationNote: The complete source index is intentionally private. Public code should reference stable abstract asset keys or approval-gated runtime records rather than private cloud identifiers.

sourceEvidenceContract.packetOwner: UrAi private source authority + Studio scene truth
invariants: equal byte size is not deduplication proof
capture time is not promoted from file/cloud timestamps without proof
filenames and folders are provenance labels, not identity proof
generated media never becomes recorded source truth
precise GPS remains private by default
